nav.label: Found children
nav.sub: Register a child found alone so their trail isn't lost

report.title: Register a found child
report.intro: If you found a child alone —in rubble, a shelter, a hospital, the street— register them here so we don't lose track of them.
report.privacyNote: Only the name is shown publicly. Location, photo, contact and the rest stay private and are used only to protect the child and track their whereabouts.
report.reporterName: Full name of the person completing this form
report.childNamePlaceholder: However they're known, or a nickname
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Height, build, skin/eye/hair color, clothing, distinguishing marks...
report.lastSeenAt: When did you last see / were with them?
report.hospital: Hospital or health center where they were treated
report.directContact: Did you have direct contact with this child?
report.directYes: Yes, I was present or attended to them directly
report.directNo: No, I received this information from another source
report.infoSource: If from another source, where does the information come from?
report.infoSourceDetailHint: E.g. @instagram_user / John Doe / Children's Hospital of Caracas / Red Cross list
report.notesHint: More detail on where they were, who with, and their condition. Anything that helps track them.

list.title: Registered children
list.intro: Names of children registered after being found alone. If you recognize a name, contact the child-protection authorities.
list.privacyNote: For child protection, only the name is shown here. The rest is released in a controlled way after verification.

detail.publicNotice: For child protection, only the name is shown publicly. The record and whereabouts history are managed by child-protection authorities.
detail.createdOk: Record saved. Keep this page's link: with it you'll be able to update their whereabouts later.
detail.manageHint: You hold this record's private link. Here you see the full record and can update where the child is and with whom.
detail.evPlacement: Type of place (hospital, shelter, temporary family, authority)
